description: Deactivate and permanently delete one or more Okta users by their user ID, login, email, or list of IDs.
command:
RAW_USERS="${answer1}"
UIDS=$(echo "$RAW_USERS" | grep -oE "00u[a-zA-Z0-9]+" || echo "$RAW_USERS" | tr ",;" "
" | tr -d " 	
\"'[]")
COUNT=0
DELETED=()
for uid in $UIDS; do
  [ -z "$uid" ] && continue
  curl -sS -X POST     -H "Accept: application/json"     -H "Content-Type: application/json"     -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_API_TOKEN"     "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/users/$uid/lifecycle/deactivate" >/dev/null 2>&1
  DEL_RES=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X DELETE     -H "Accept: application/json"     -H "Content-Type: application/json"     -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_API_TOKEN"     "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/users/$uid")
  if [ "$DEL_RES" = "204" ] || [ "$DEL_RES" = "200" ]; then
    DELETED+=("$uid")
    COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
    echo "  • Deleted $uid"
  else
    echo "  • Failed to delete $uid (HTTP $DEL_RES)"
  fi
done
echo "Deleted $COUNT user(s)."
python3 -c '
import sys, json
count = int(sys.argv[1])
users = sys.argv[2:]
print(json.dumps({
    "status": "success" if count > 0 else "error",
    "deleted_count": count,
    "deleted_users": users
}))
' "$COUNT" "${DELETED[@]}"
questions: What is the email, username, or ID of the user(s) to delete? (Can be a single ID, email, list of IDs, or reference like '${Search Okta Users By Dynamic Profile Attributes.user_ids}')*
